title: The long road to Spiti
subtitle: Nine days from the green hills of Shimla and Kinnaur to Spiti’s high villages, monasteries, and the blue water of Chandratal.

chapters.title: An evening in Shimla
paragraphs: The journey begins above the clouds and ends with warm food and the lights around the Ridge. Beyond the town, the mountains are waiting.

chapters.title: Forests, a lake & palace courtyards
paragraphs: Green hills give way to forest paths, a still lake, and the carved wood of palace courtyards. The road keeps winding east, towards Kinnaur.

chapters.title: Into the Baspa Valley
paragraphs: Morning begins among the timber roofs of Sarahan. Rock-cut roads lead into Kinnaur, then along the Baspa towards Chitkul, where cloud lifts from the snow peaks before evening.

chapters.title: Apple orchards & carved doorways
paragraphs: The Baspa runs bright beneath the forest. Apples hang beside village paths, and carved wooden doorways mark the stops between Sangla and Kalpa.

chapters.title: From sunrise to the high desert
paragraphs: Sunbeams spread above the ridgeline at Kalpa. The road follows deep river gorges into a drier landscape, pausing among the stone lanes, monastery walls, and quiet water of Nako. Painted details and evening light at Gue mark the last stop before Tabo.

chapters.title: Earthen temples & river valleys
paragraphs: Pale earthen walls hold the morning light at Tabo. Above the river, Dhankar rises from eroded rock; farther along, painted monastery rooms and a narrow footbridge lead into the open space of Pin Valley.

chapters.title: Above the valley
paragraphs: From Pin Valley, the road climbs towards the high villages above Kaza. Bright monastery paint, a Buddha against the sky, mountain sheep, and long views across the plateau fill the day.

chapters.title: Monasteries, a gorge & the blue lake
paragraphs: White monastery buildings rise above the river at Key. The road continues through Kibber and Chicham, crosses the high country around Kunzum, and reaches Chandratal, where clouds and mountain shadows move across the water.

chapters.title: Back towards the green hills
paragraphs: A snowy summit catches the first light above camp. On the road towards Manali, bare slopes gradually give way to green meadows and conifer-covered hills.
